title: Hometown Fair Saturday, Scaredown Torrance, last chance SOAR
intro: Manhattan Beach runs its free Hometown Fair all weekend, Old Torrance does Scaredown Saturday night, and SOAR butterflies at South Coast Botanic Garden end Sunday. Cards below. We left parking, food, and prices blank unless we could confirm them on an official page.

picks.name: Manhattan Beach Hometown Fair
picks.when: Saturday–Sunday, October 3–4, 10:00 a.m.–6:00 p.m. (Opening Parade Saturday 10:00 a.m.)
picks.address: Live Oak Park, Dorsey Field & Joslyn Center / Valley Drive area
picks.cost_math: 2 adults + 2 kids: free admission. Kid Country (petting zoo, inflatables, magic and animal shows) free per attractions page. Paid games and food booths extra.
picks.parking: Official FAQ: accessible parking first-come in Civic Center Lot (Highland & 15th, placard). General parking details sparse — street/lot congestion expected; cost unknown.
picks.food: Nonprofit food booths on Live Oak and Dorsey fields; shaded seating by Main Stage. Beer/wine gardens are adult. Prices not listed.
picks.why: Flagship free hometown fair with Kid Country and a Saturday morning parade. Crowds are real — go early.
picks.venue_name: Live Oak Park, Dorsey Field & Joslyn Center

picks.name: Scaredown in Downtown Torrance
picks.address: Old Torrance — Discover Torrance lists 1313 Sartori Ave (event also cited near 1266 Sartori)
picks.cost_math: 2 adults + 2 kids: free outdoor community event (DTA volunteer-run). Optional $10 commemorative bag at DTA booth. Family Fun Zone (bounce house, crafts) included.
picks.parking: Free lots: Sartori structure, Destination Art (1815 W 213th), Cravens lot, street. Paid Wells Fargo lot. Free shuttle every 15 min 3:30–10:00 p.m. from Wilson Park (2200 Crenshaw) courtesy Supervisor Hahn.
picks.food: Downtown restaurants open with seasonal specials; candy from businesses. Adult drinks at some spots.
picks.why: Costume trunk-or-treat, Family Fun Zone, DJ and dance — easy Halloween street night without tickets.

picks.name: Magic of the Jack O'Lanterns
picks.when: Select nights Friday–Sunday, October 2–4 (season runs select nights through November 1; timed tickets via Zentix)
picks.address: South Coast Botanic Garden, 26300 Crenshaw Blvd (use this address — apps may misroute)
picks.cost_math: 2 adults + 2 kids: ticket prices vary by night and tier. Live cart prices were not readable as a static table this week — confirm in the Zentix widget before you buy. Secondary ticketing help cites GA from about $29.99 adult / $24.99 kids on select nights. Parking cost not listed on the LA event page (ignore Denver/Hudson Gardens parking copy on other MOTJ pages).
picks.parking: Official LA page does not list a parking fee for South Coast Botanic Garden. Use 26300 Crenshaw Blvd.
picks.food: Food and beverages on site (official). Cashless event. Fun Zone / food trucks vary by night.
picks.why: Lit pumpkin trail plus family Fun Zone. Still early in the season — check which nights are open.

picks.name: SOAR: Tropical Butterflies (last days)
picks.when: Through Sunday, October 4, 2026 (last day) — timed entry
picks.address: South Coast Botanic Garden, 26300 Crenshaw Blvd
picks.cost_math: 2 adults + 2 kids (ages 3–12): non-member SOAR+garden $27 + $27 + $17 + $17 = $88 entry (ages 0–2 free). Optional butterfly feeding $6 per feeder. Timed advance tickets required. Parking cost not confirmed on the SOAR page this week → total unknown.
picks.parking: Official SOAR page does not list a parking fee this pass. Use garden entrance on Crenshaw.
picks.food: Garden café / on-site options typical; SOAR page does not break out food prices. No strollers in the butterfly pavilion (official).
picks.why: Last chance this weekend for the tropical butterfly pavilion plus garden admission.
picks.price_text: Non-member SOAR + garden $27 adults, $17 ages 3–12, ages 0–2 free

picks.name: Cabrillo Beach Cleanup
picks.address: Cabrillo Marine Aquarium, 3720 Stephen M. White Drive (meet steps in front of auditorium)
picks.cost_math: 2 adults + 2 kids: free program, all ages. Groups reserve by Thursday before: 310-548-7562. Parking $3/hr, $9 daily max, card only → about $9 if you stay for the cleanup.
picks.parking: Cabrillo Beach lot: $3/hr, $9 daily max, credit/debit only (CMA admission/hours page).
picks.food: Official event page does not list food. Picnic areas nearby in Cabrillo Coastal Park.
picks.why: Hands-on beach stewardship before the rest of Saturday fills up.

picks.name: Storytime Tails – Batty Bats
picks.address: White Point Nature Education Center, 1600 W. Paseo Del Mar
picks.cost_math: 2 adults + 2 kids: no admission price on the PVPLC event page (treat as free). Stories, crafts, hands-on nature.
picks.parking: Preserve parking at White Point (gravel lot at end of street per PVPLC pattern). Official listing does not list a fee.
picks.food: Official listing does not list food. Eat first or pack light.
picks.why: Preschool Halloween-adjacent nature storytime on the bluff.

picks.name: PVPLC 1st Saturday Guided Nature Walk — George F Canyon
picks.city: Rancho Palos Verdes / Rolling Hills Estates
picks.address: George F Canyon Nature Preserve, 27305 Palos Verdes Dr E — park dirt lot west side of PVDE ~400 ft south of PVDN; meet Stein Hale trailhead
picks.cost_math: 2 adults + 2 kids: free guided walk (listed under Activities for Families). RSVP via PVPLC calendar. Rain cancels.
picks.parking: Dirt lot on west side of Palos Verdes Drive East (~400 ft south of Palos Verdes Drive North).
picks.food: Official listing does not list food. Eat first.
picks.why: Easy free canyon walk with naturalists — good Saturday morning before the fair or Scaredown.

picks.name: Turtle and Tortoise Day
picks.address: Madrona Marsh Nature Center, 3201 Plaza del Amo
picks.cost_math: 2 adults + 2 kids: no admission price on the Friends of Madrona Marsh page (treat as free). California Turtle and Tortoise Society brings live turtles and tortoises — hands-on, all ages.
picks.parking: Nature Center lot. Official page does not list a fee.
picks.food: Official page does not list food.
picks.why: Very popular Madrona day — live turtles and tortoises for all ages.

picks.name: Festa Italiana Los Angeles
picks.when: Saturday, October 10, 11:00 a.m.–10:00 p.m. (live entertainment from about 3:00 p.m.)
picks.address: 6th St between S. Palos Verdes & S. Centre (nav: 222 W 6th St)
picks.cost_math: 2 adults + 2 kids: free entry and entertainment. Food and merch paid. Topaz Garage on Centre (5th–6th) $10 flat Saturday 10:30 a.m.–midnight → entry $0 + parking about $10 if you use the garage.
picks.parking: Street first-come; Topaz Building garage on Centre St $10 flat Sat 10:30 a.m.–midnight (official FAQ). Meters $0.50/half-hour before 6 p.m.
picks.food: 20+ Italian food vendors; kids games and photo experiences; beer garden for adults. Dogs on leash OK.
picks.why: Big free Italian street festa with kids activities. Strong October Saturday in San Pedro.
picks.venue_name: 6th St between S. Palos Verdes & S. Centre

picks.name: Sea Scare! Monsters of Myth
picks.when: Saturday, October 17, 7:00–10:00 p.m. (food trucks 5:00 p.m.; members early entry 6:00 p.m.)
picks.address: Cabrillo Marine Aquarium, 3720 Stephen M. White Drive
picks.cost_math: 2 adults + 2 kids: pre-sale non-members $18 + $18 + $12 + $12 = $60 entry. Event sells out — buy online. Parking may differ on special-event nights; daytime lot is $3/hr, $9 daily max card-only (confirm event night).
picks.parking: Cabrillo Beach lot rules on CMA admission page ($3/hr, $9 daily max, card only). Special-event night parking not separately priced on the Sea Scare page.
picks.food: Food trucks from 5:00 p.m. (official). Prices not listed.
picks.why: One-night aquarium Halloween — trick-or-treat, games, crafts, DJ, costume contest, family haunted house. Tickets matter.

picks.name: RPV Trunk or Treat
picks.address: Ken Dyda Civic Center, 30940 Hawthorne Blvd
picks.cost_math: 2 adults + 2 kids: free. Decorated trunks, inflatables, face painting, games, costume parade, puppet show/music. Food vendors for purchase.
picks.parking: Free parking at Civic Center plus free shuttle from Point Vicente Interpretive Center, 31501 Palos Verdes Dr West (official flyer).
picks.food: Food vendors on site. Prices not listed on flyer.
picks.why: City trunk-or-treat with inflatables and costume parade. Same day as Sea Scare — pick day or night.

picks.name: Friday Fun at Madrona Marsh
picks.when: Friday, October 2, 10:00 a.m.–12:00 p.m. (also Fridays ongoing, e.g. Oct 9 & 16)
picks.address: Madrona Marsh Nature Center, 3201 Plaza del Amo
picks.cost_math: Free. Pre-register Tuesday 10:00 a.m. the same week: (310) 782-3989; first 20.
picks.parking: Nature Center lot. Official page does not list a fee.
picks.food: Official page does not list food.
picks.why: Hands-on preschool nature (story, science, art, tour).

picks.name: Cabrillo Nature Journaling
picks.address: Cabrillo Marine Aquarium lower courtyard, 3720 Stephen M. White Drive
picks.cost_math: Free, all ages, no registration; materials provided. Parking up to $9/day card only.
picks.parking: Cabrillo Beach lot: $3/hr, $9 daily max, card only.
picks.food: Official calendar does not list food.
picks.why: Open all-ages animal ID and journaling — calm Sunday morning.

picks.name: Cephalopod Awareness Week (drop-in)
picks.when: Sunday, October 4, 2:00–5:00 p.m. (continues Oct 6–10 with daytime slots)
picks.address: Cabrillo Marine Aquarium Exhibit Hall, 3720 Stephen M. White Drive
picks.cost_math: Aquarium suggested donation $10 adult / $5 child (not required). Parking up to $9/day card only.
picks.parking: Cabrillo Beach lot: $3/hr, $9 daily max, card only.
picks.food: Official calendar does not list food.
picks.why: Interactive cephalopod learning during regular visit hours.

picks.name: Hermosa Beach Pumpkins in the Park
picks.address: Edith Rodaway Friendship Park, 350 Prospect Ave
picks.cost_math: Date and place confirmed on Humanitix registration. City calendar Access Denied this week; program details (decorating, parade) not listed on the thin registration page — re-check before you go. Cost not stated.
picks.why: Watch list — Hermosa pumpkin morning; confirm city detail page.

picks.name: Treats-n-Suites Halloween Bash
picks.address: Dignity Health Sports Park, 18400 Avalon Blvd
picks.cost_math: Official page lists about $8.77 per ticket incl. fees; ages 2–11 + families. Confirm whether adults need tickets before totaling a family of 4. Trick-or-treat, hayride, carnival games, costume parade.
picks.why: Watch list — paid kids Halloween bash near South Bay.

picks.name: ICAN Inclusive Halloween Festival
picks.address: South Bay Regional Computing Center (SCROC), 2300 Crenshaw
picks.cost_math: Free festival for people with disabilities (all ages) and families/caregivers. Food and merch for purchase.
picks.why: Watch list — inclusive Halloween fest same day as RPV Trunk or Treat.

picks.name: MB World Famous Pumpkin Race
picks.when: Sunday, October 18, 2026 (races often ~2:00 p.m.; festival window reported noon–5)
picks.address: Pier / Manhattan Beach Blvd area — confirm on city page
picks.cost_math: City pumpkinrace page Access Denied from research tools this week. Tourism/guides cite free to watch; kit prices unconfirmed on city HTML. Re-verify manhattanbeach.gov before listing as a firm pick.
picks.why: Watch list — iconic MB pumpkin race; city site blocked this pass.

picks.name: Magic of the Jack O'Lanterns (ongoing)
picks.when: Select nights through November 1, 2026 (e.g. Oct 8–11, 14–18 reported on secondary schedules — confirm Zentix)
picks.address: South Coast Botanic Garden, 26300 Crenshaw Blvd
picks.cost_math: Ticket + parking verify per night in Zentix.
picks.why: Watch list — multi-week paid night walk; tickets sell on peak nights.
